question.prompt: If \(\log 2=0.3010\) and \(\log 3=0.4771,\) the value of \(x\) when \(3^{x+3}=135\) is approximately:

solutions.explanation:
Since \(135=27\cdot5=3^3\cdot5\), dividing the given equation by \(3^3\) gives \(3^x=5\). Logarithms are useful here because the unknown is an exponent. By the definition of a logarithm and the change-of-base formula,
\[
x=\log_3 5=\frac{\log5}{\log3}.
\]
The given logarithms are common logarithms, so
\[
\log5=\log\frac{10}{2}=1-\log2=0.6990.
\]
Because \(\log3=0.4771\ne0\), we may divide to obtain
\[
x\approx\frac{0.6990}{0.4771}\approx1.4651.
\]
Thus \(x\) is approximately \(1.47\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
solutions.title: Simplify the power, then use logarithms
